summary: REPAIR ROUND 6 of TASK-006 (repair_rounds_used 5 -> 6), fixing the one blocking defect and the four prose over-claims from independent review round 6 (reviewer 078b67a7), which had independently confirmed that both round-5 fixes are real and that F-R4-1 remains closed. Small targeted repair only: the self-healing guard, the predicate and the deferral behaviour were NOT restructured. Changed exactly src/stores/queueStore.ts (900 -> 966 lines) and src/hooks/useImageGeneratorExecution.ts (comment only). FINDING 1 (blocking, the reason round 6 failed): the round-5 deferral loop for(;;) had NO pass cap and its termination argument was provably false on two counts - (a) on the normal path there is no third-party writer yet healPending is still set by heal OWN write (updateNodeData then set(nodes) whose subscription fires synchronously inside set while healingQueuedMarkers is true), so if (!healPending) break never broke on the normal path and the real exit was the next pass having zero candidates; (b) the reviewer built a writer that is BOUNDED ON ITS OWN and it oscillated 202 passes inside one 10ms sync stack, falsifying the claim that only an unbounded writer could sustain it. Fix: added const MAX_HEAL_PASSES = 8 at queueStore.ts:882 with a passes counter (:915/:918) and a console.warn + break at :939, placed AFTER if (!healPending) break so the deferral semantics are untouched, and the zero-candidate early return still sits BEFORE the reentrancy flag and before any write so F-R3-2 is intact; the termination prose now attributes the exit to the next pass having zero candidates. The cap honest cost is stated in-code: beyond the cap a heal may be missed (measured: the marker is still true at cap exit) and recovery requires a later nodes identity change. FINDINGS 2-5 fixed: :646 the (marker|status) enumeration is now explicitly NON-exhaustive with true|idle added (the one-directional invariant is explicitly kept and it is still correct because false|loading alone disproves the reverse); Finding 3 exit-mechanism prose corrected; Finding 4 the hook claim about write sites is corrected to the truthful THREE sites (imageGenerationExecution.ts:267 job start plus :213/:227 failure paths) with the conclusion retained for a corrected reason; Finding 5 the transitive-dependency count corrected to 21 in-repo plus 7 bare externals with 0 back-edges (the substantive 0-back-edge claim kept). Two further over-claims the worker caught ITSELF: the import.meta.hot sentence claimed the repo had none anywhere but the reviewer grep hit that very sentence, so it was reworded to except the sentence itself; and two cross-references to hook lines 131-135 that its own edit had shifted were updated to the correct lines. MANAGER INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION on the static tree with all workers stopped: gate 6/6 PASS exit 0 and tsc --noEmit exit 0 (the gate is BLIND to undo/redo and to all of these findings, so it is not offered as evidence for them). Manager verified the cap is genuinely present by reading the source: MAX_HEAL_PASSES at :882, passes at :915 and :918, and the warn+break guard at :939. WORKER-SUPPLIED EVIDENCE the manager reviewed but did not re-run (stated plainly): a new 4-mode probe shows the real pathological writer stops at the cap with a warn in 1ms while a cap-disabled mutant runs past 5000 passes, a bounded writer reproduces the oscillation (200,000+ passes in 3.49s), and a counters mutant shows the normal path is ONE pass with the !healPending exit hit zero times; the worker also reported that instrumentation corrected its own first draft which had claimed two passes. The worker additionally performed a controlled A/B showing that two worker-era probes (r6-fix1-feedback with 4 FAILs, r6-window-hunt with 1 FAIL) produce BYTE-IDENTICAL failures with the cap disabled, i.e. they are fixture bugs (sleep(120) landing on the 4th job boundary; an n=4 click enqueues +4 jobs while the assertion expects +1) and not regressions; the manager records this as the worker claim it is. A fresh independent reviewer is REQUIRED next and none is claimed here. Known-broken probes whose crashes are not signals: probe-r4-attrib2 and probe-r4-undo-attrib (encoding corruption at parse), probe-r4-decisive (crashes in its own logging).
